summary: Once is a Rust CLI that caches the output of other commands to speed up repetitive tasks. It runs locally without needing an API key and is installed in under 15 seconds. The tool is aimed at developers who repeatedly run the same CLI commands and want quick results. Its main strength is the convenience of caching, but limited documentation, unclear use cases, and no integration API are notable drawbacks.
